Security details

For shares: the highest price on NSE/BSE on 31 Jan 2018. For mutual funds: the NAV on 31 Jan 2018. Used for grandfathering in Schedule 112A.

Import

How prices work. Refresh live prices needs internet. Mutual fund NAVs come from mfapi.in, which republishes AMFI's official daily NAVs. Stock prices come from Yahoo Finance (NSE) through a public relay; only stock symbols are sent, never your holdings or account. If live prices fail, use price files instead: download them, then click Load price files and pick them (several at once is fine).
  1. Stocks (NSE): on nseindia.com/all-reports, download CM-UDiFF Common Bhavcopy Final or Full Bhavcopy and Security Deliverable data. Unzip it if it comes as a .zip.
  2. Stocks (BSE): on bseindia.com Bhavcopy, download the Equity UDiFF bhavcopy.
  3. Mutual funds (AMFI): open amfiindia.com NAVAll.txt and save the page (Ctrl+S).
